propositions: Pre-existing tickets store contains 550 stale-channel, 10 orphan-event, and 1 status-fork-resolved diagnostics that must be remediated in a controlled quiet window.
All 10 orphan events are LINK-type and AUTO-RECOVER eligible; zero require human triage; they span 9 mixed tickets plus 1 orphan-only ticket.

Safety tooling (Gerrit 1391) implements scoped stale-channel repair with batching, dry-run immutability, mixed-fault refusal, and resumable --limit; backward compatibility with existing --repair behavior is preserved.

Repair execution order is AUTO-RECOVER orphan repair first, then stale-channel batches with --limit=200, followed by verification that residual contains only 4 intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit records.

Live quiet-window repair successfully committed and pushed all orphan and stale-channel fixes; post-repair fsck confirms zero repairable diagnostics remain and the exact four audit records are preserved.
